baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالُوا ... نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَى أَن تَجْعَلَ ... سَدًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers negotiate a defined outgoing payment for an assigned act of construction, joining contribution, builder, community, and barrier in one public-works compact.

activation_trace.role: Mutual negotiation makes the utterance a proposal with terms rather than an undifferentiated plea.
An assigned fee for work binds the offered making to the requested making.
Money going out on a specified basis supplies the compact's assessable contribution.
Filling a breach supplies the concrete deliverable of the negotiated work.

changed_reading.before: A threatened group asks a powerful traveler to put up a wall for payment.
changed_reading.after: A community tenders a public-works compact: a specified contribution is exchanged for closing a breach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ... بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا
baseline_models.mechanism: Corruption drives a lived environment out of fitness, while the doubled between and breach-fill locate repair in the relation between two groups; the barrier governs contact rather than erasing either side.

activation_trace.role: Departure from soundness defines the reported harm as systemic loss of fitness.
Soft productive earth gives the damaged order a livelihood-bearing substrate.
A relation standing between parties locates the intervention in their contested interface.
What fills a deficiency casts the barrier as remedial infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: Bad actors are to be kept away by a wall.
changed_reading.after: A damaged communal environment is repaired by installing a controlled interface at its breach.

context_deltas.mechanism: Empowered capacity follows a connecting means until it reaches the between-barriers bottleneck, so the request becomes the local application of already routed capability.

activation_trace.role: Empowerment supplies the operative capacity later solicited by the community.
A rope or connecting means supplies a conduit for movement and resources.
Tracing one mark after another supplies directed pursuit along that conduit.
Reaching an endpoint identifies the between-barriers site as the trajectory's destination.
The focus breach-fill anchors routed capacity in the requested repair.

structural_cues: Following a sabab recurs in 18:85, 18:89, and 18:92 before arrival between the barriers in 18:93.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies empowerment, a connection, repeated following, and arrival; I infer a logistics arrow toward a bottleneck. Alternatively, sabab may mark route alone.

changed_reading.before: The barrier request is an isolated local episode.
changed_reading.after: The request is where mobile capacity is finally routed into a precise infrastructural bottleneck.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier absence of covering sharpens the requested barrier into deliberate protection for an exposed population.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies an explicit negative case of a people left physically exposed.
Filling a need turns absent cover into constructed protection.

structural_cues: The explicit lack of ستر in 18:90 precedes the later community's request for a سد.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one community without cover and another requesting closure; I infer a contrast from exposure to protection. The alternative is that their material conditions are unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The سد is only a military blockade.
changed_reading.after: The سد also answers a recurring problem of human exposure through site-specific cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near-failure of comprehension immediately becomes negotiated speech, making the proposal a hard-won communicative crossing rather than a frictionless contract.

activation_trace.role: Non-occurrence under negation intensifies the limit on communicative access.
Grasping and understanding names the capacity that is almost unavailable.
The focus inventory's negotiation branch makes poorly understood speech the medium to be crossed.
The same negotiation image anchors the successful proposal in the focus utterance.

structural_cues: Scarcely understanding speech in 18:93 is followed immediately by a structured conditional proposal in 18:94.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near-incomprehension followed by a proposal; I infer mediation or effort across the gap. Alternatively, this particular exchange may have been directly understood.

changed_reading.before: The parties transparently negotiate ordinary terms.
changed_reading.after: The compact is itself an achievement across a comprehension barrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offered payment is displaced by already-held capacity and a request for communal assistance in concentrated strength; commissioned work becomes co-produced repair.

activation_trace.role: Empowerment supplies an existing resource valued above the proposed payment.
Mutual assistance transfers the community from payer to participant.
Strength gathered like rope strands makes their contribution collective force.
Packing a breach specifies the collaborative work as dense gap repair.
The focus payment image supplies the proposal revised by the response.

structural_cues: ما مكني فيه ربي خير answers the proposed خرج, and فأعينوني بقوة replaces payment language with assistance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior empowerment, aid, gathered strength, and rدم; I infer that labor or resources replace the levy. Alternatively, خرج may already include in-kind labor.

changed_reading.before: Clients hire a powerful builder to deliver a wall.
changed_reading.after: The builder mobilizes the clients' own force, converting commission into cooperative infrastructure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Iron units are aligned between mountain sides, heated by blown air, and covered by poured molten metal; the generic breach-fill becomes a staged composite seal.

activation_trace.role: A gathered piece or mass supplies modular iron units for the fill.
Iron and resistant hardness supply the structure's main material.
Equalizing two things supplies controlled alignment across the opening.
Raised mountain sides supply the two structural abutments.
Sending air into a thing supplies active thermal processing.
Pouring by emptying a vessel supplies the coating or infilling operation.
Molten copper supplies a flowing metallic phase that seals the heated structure.
The focus breach-fill anchors every material operation in the requested barrier.

structural_cues: Imperatives and repeated حتى إذا clauses stage collection, alignment, heating, and pouring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies units, iron, aligned sides, air, pouring, and molten copper; I infer a bonded composite seal. A layered coating without deep bonding remains possible.

changed_reading.after: سد becomes process architecture: aligned iron masses are thermally worked and sealed with poured metal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The completed barrier is tested against going over and opening through, so breach-filling acquires vertical and through-thickness integrity.

activation_trace.role: Capability, twice negated, frames both attack modes as failed capacities.
Rising above and overcoming supplies the overtopping mode.
Opening through to the far side supplies the penetration mode.
The focus gap closure is strengthened by resistance to bypass and perforation.

structural_cues: Parallel فما استطاعوا ... وما استطاعوا clauses assign a distinct complement to each negated capability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inability, rising over, and piercing through; I infer a two-vector performance test. ظهر could alternatively mean generic conquest.

changed_reading.before: The barrier closes the visible opening.
changed_reading.after: The barrier is validated as a three-dimensional defense against overtopping and through-breach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The barrier is named mercy, placed under a true appointed horizon, and destined to be demolished into levelness; successful closure is provisional care rather than permanent mastery.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tenderness classify the completed infrastructure as care.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the work's appointed horizon.
Demolition until level supplies the barrier's eventual reversal.
Reality-fixed truth makes the promised expiry certain rather than contingent.
The focus closure remains the useful intervention whose permanence is revised.

structural_cues: هذا رحمة names the work, while فإذا جاء وعد ربي makes its flattening temporal and reverses the focus's making.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, an appointed promise, demolition, and truth; I infer that temporary protection is part of the work's meaning. The promise's exact horizon remains unstated.

changed_reading.before: The requested سد aims at permanent security.
changed_reading.after: Its durability serves a bounded mercy whose truthful horizon includes its own unmaking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a branch image latent in the title resonate with later engineering; it does not claim the title literally means builder or clamp. It remains anchored in ذي القرنين and سد and is supported by the joined mountain sides. Downstream prose should mark it as structural resonance, not etymological identification.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies a latent binding signature in the title.
Raised mountain sides supply the two physical members joined by the work.
Filling the breach anchors the title resonance in the requested construction.

changed_reading.before: The title is functionally incidental to the request.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its joining image anticipates the task of binding two sides across a breach.

strongest_changes: Paid public works is revised into infrastructure co-produced through communal assistance and gathered strength.
The generic سد becomes a staged composite seal tested against overtopping and penetration.
The barrier is reframed as provisional mercy whose true horizon includes demolition.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope changes a terse request at three levels: difficult speech becomes a compact, money becomes participation, and a seemingly final boundary becomes temporary care.
remaining_uncertainties: خرج may already include in-kind contribution.
The exact metallurgical bonding process is inferred.
The title-as-binding reading remains an exploratory resonance.
